newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Zeitler-German banking should be simpler.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Zeitler-German banking should be simpler.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Franz-Christoph Zeitler said on Monday that Germany's bureaucratic banking system should be simplified and deregulated to help boost the county's economic efficiency.

"An attempt to regulate everything in detail is bound to failure from the start," Zeitler wrote. He said that in his view criticism of Germany's increasingly bureaucratic bank regulation was justified.

Zeitler suggested that one solution for the short term would be to remove the special standards in Germany, which he said were not required by European Union law and did not help to improve regulatory efficiency.
